# Peak

> Peak is a personal fitness and nutrition tracker. It logs workouts and personal
> records, body weight, habits, and food, and includes an AI assistant that can
> enter data from a conversation, a photo, or a barcode scan.

## What it does

- Workouts: organize training into sections, movements, and variations, and
  track weight/rep history and personal records over time.
- Body weight: log entries and view trends over time.
- Habits: define habits and tally daily completion.
- Nutrition: log food entries and macros, including from a barcode scan or a
  photo of a meal.
- AI assistant: a chat interface that can propose workout, body weight,
  habit, and nutrition entries for the user to confirm.

## Pages

- [Sign up](https://peakhq.me/sign-up): create an account
- [Sign in](https://peakhq.me/sign-in): sign in to an existing account
- [App](https://peakhq.me/): the tracker itself (requires sign-in)
